Hi Marcus / Vanessa —

Thanks again for the demo this week. Aurum's procurement team asked for a short write-up that shows: 1) how Redwood would equalize list/pricing tiers between our US and Canada customers for private offers, and 2) the expected pass-through / dealer margin mechanics for our value-added reseller network.

Attached is a quick workbook with our desired volume bands and the channel partner % targets. Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- replicate identical SKU prices across regions (USD/CAD parity) while preserving tax handling at invoice time, and
- support a two-line item private offer where the dealer fee is passed as a separate credit line so our resellers receive reporting?

We'd like to lock initial economics by next week to feed our Q4 procurement cycle.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call.

Best,

Alyssa —

Thanks for the workbook and the clear asks. Short answers up-front:
- Yes, we can present equivalent list prices across US/CAN private-offer SKUs (you can pin a USD figure and we’ll show a CAD overlay). Tax/VAT remains handled at invoice time per seller jurisdiction — that won't change list parity.
- We support a separate dealer-fee pass-through line on private-offer invoices; many partners use this to keep reseller P&L clean and enable downstream reporting.

Notes / clarifying asks:
1) Channel fee flow: Do you want Redwood to remit the dealer fee directly to resellers (we can support payout hooks) or to route it as an invoice credit that Aurum will distribute?
2) Currency rounding: For parity we do two options — hard-peg (same nominal numbers in USD/CAD) or FX-adjust (keep net $ equivalent). The workbook assumes hard-peg; confirm.
3) SLA cliff: If you want a guaranteed latency SLA across regions that maps to pricing tiers, that affects reserved capacity pricing.

I've attached a short playbook (PDF) that explains how we model channel pass-throughs and sample invoice lines. Vanessa and Ben — can you weigh in on margin % sensitivity and whether we should propose a simple 3-tier pass-through (5/3/1%) or layer it by reseller role?

If helpful I can put together a draft private-offer JSON that shows line items and credits for your legal & procurement team. Suggest a 30-min sync Monday (Aug 31) to finalize the approach.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference
